description: WHAT: Rank Einsatzgebiete by an ICBM 'lat, lng' string (optional lat/lng, radius_km, limit). RETURNS items with distance_km. USE when the user pastes ICBM metadata. Prefer find_by_geo instead for plain lat/lng without an ICBM string. (0,0) and far points → ok=false outside_service_area. DOES NOT route or drive-time. NEXT: get_service_area, get_embed_map, get_grenze.

icbm.description: ICBM or paste 'lat, lng' (comma-separated). Alternative to lat+lng.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude. Required with lng unless icbm is set. (0,0) → outside_service_area.

limit.description: Maximum items or lines to return after offset. Omit = all remaining in the window (subject to tool-specific clamps). For geo near-search default is often 5 without radius_km, up to 52 with radius.

lng.description: WGS84 longitude. Required with lat unless icbm is set.

radius_km.description: Optional air-radius filter in km. Omit = return nearest N (limit). Far points / (0,0) → outside_service_area.

name: find_by_icbm
title: Find By Icbm
